question: {If } ( 8.5 div 0.25 + (26)/(3) div (1)/(3) ) { of } (3)/(50) = 0.01 { of } P, { then the value of } P { is}: 5479
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert divisions quickly:

8.5 ÷ 0.25 = 34 and (26/3) ÷ (1/3) = 26

Sum = 34 + 26 = 60

⇒ 60 × (3/50) = 3.6

**∴ 0.01P = 3.6 ⇒ P = 360**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(8.5 ÷ 0.25 + (26/3) ÷ (1/3)) of (3/50) = 0.01P

**Formula used:**

Division of fractions ⇒ a ÷ (b/c) = a × (c/b)

**Calculation:**

⇒ 8.5 ÷ 0.25 = 8.5 × 4 = 34

⇒ (26/3) ÷ (1/3) = (26/3) × 3 = 26

⇒ Sum = 34 + 26 = 60

⇒ 60 × (3/50) = 180/50 = 3.6

⇒ 0.01P = 3.6

⇒ P = 3.6 ÷ 0.01 = 360

**∴ The correct answer is 360.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Division by Decimal

Dividing by 0.25 is same as multiplying by 4

Fraction Division Rule

a ÷ (b/c) = a × (c/b)

Percentage Conversion

0.01 = 1/100, so multiply RHS accordingly
